title: Generating sum for Krawtchouk values
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, $x\\in\\{\\pm1\\}^n$, and $\\rho\\in\\mathbb R$. For each $j$, sum $\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ over all $j$-element subsets $S\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$; the sum of these values weighted by $\\rho^j$, for $j=0,\\ldots,n$, equals $\\sum_{S\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}}\\left(\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i\\right)\\rho^{|S|}$.�
